title: VFX stack on a generated plate
pitch: Generate a street, empty it, turn it to night, flood it. Every stage side by side.
why: LTX-2.5's IC-LoRAs are made to be stacked: each pass takes the last pass's clip as its source. The grid shows one plate through three effects.

fields.label: The plate, in plain words
fields.default: a narrow cobblestone street in an old stone town, a woman in a yellow raincoat walking toward the camera

models.name: LTX-2.5 with IC-LoRAs
models.note: Paid licence above US$10,000,000 annual revenue.

models.name: ffmpeg
models.licence: LGPL/GPL, runs as a separate tool

tips: Describe the scene the same way in each pass.
Water at 1.3 is the card's stronger setting; 1.0 proved subtle.

steps.label: All four together
steps.what: Puts the versions next to each other with labels.

expected.basis: sum of each step's measured time on this box, with a cold start per step

raw_steps.label: Generate the plate
raw_steps.prompt: A woman in a yellow raincoat walks slowly toward the camera along a narrow cobblestone street in an old stone town, the camera pulls back at her walking pace, soft overcast daylight, footsteps on stone.

raw_steps.label: Clear the plate
raw_steps.scene: a narrow cobblestone street in an old stone town

raw_steps.label: Day to night
raw_steps.scene: a narrow cobblestone street in an old stone town

raw_steps.label: Flood it
raw_steps.scene: a narrow cobblestone street in an old stone town at night
raw_steps.prompt: a rising flood of dark water that surges along the street and splashes against the walls
